answer: Persistent Inquiry Ledger. Identities gain weight only by answering unpredictable, context-specific challenges whose correct answers take minutes of real inference to derive but are cheap to verify. Rewards accrue slowly, like melt from a glacier. A long quiet period quarantines an account as a haven for bots. Each new identity must clear a quartz-hard calibration quiz scored against live agent output. Attacker cost: sustained per-identity attention across weeks, which scales linearly and cannot be parallelized cheaply.
